key_insight: The paper introduces MM-Lifelong, a 181.1-hour multimodal dataset organized at Day, Week, and Month scales to expose real-world, unscripted temporal structure, and shows that current end-to-end MLLM approaches fail on long-range temporal abstraction and memory retention; an agentic baseline is proposed to mitigate these issues.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between short, densely concatenated video clips used in benchmarks and natural lifelong multimodal data, enabling evaluation and development of models that must reason across varying temporal densities and retain long-term context.
method: Curate and release MM-Lifelong: 181.1 hours of footage organized into Day / Week / Month scales to capture different temporal densities and realistic lifelog structure.

Systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art end-to-end MLLMs on the dataset, identifying two major failure modes: poor long-range temporal abstraction and degradation of memory/recall across extended time scales.

Design an agentic baseline that decomposes the task (e.g., modular memory, retrieval over multi-scale time windows, and an agent loop around the MLLM) to improve robustness to lifelong multimodal inputs.
impact: Provides a benchmark and baseline that focus community effort on long-term multimodal reasoning, memory mechanisms, and agentic strategies—critical for real-world AI that must understand and act on life-scale audiovisual data.
visual_elements: Multi-scale timeline diagram (Day / Week / Month) showing dataset coverage and example clips at each scale.
Statistic card: 181.1 hours total, breakdown by scale, sample count and modalities (audio + video + metadata).
Failure-mode schematic contrasting short-range success vs long-range collapse (temporal abstraction and memory loss).
Architecture flowchart of the agentic baseline: input stream → multi-scale retriever/memory → MLLM reasoning → action/response loop.
paper_title: Towards Multimodal Lifelong Understanding: A Dataset and Agentic Baseline
paper_authors: Guo Chen, Lidong Lu, Yicheng Liu, Liangrui Dong, Lidong Zou
